title: BioIVT: tumour location questions become a type-ahead ICD-O-3 tumour site lookup
description: Turns the free-text Tumor Location question on Oncology and Confirmed Tumor Location on the BioIVT oncology form into a type-ahead lookup over the ICD-O-3 site groups published by SEER (82 groups, such as Lung and bronchus, Breast, Colon). The stored value is the SEER site recode range. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Dan's decision: ICD-O-3 for tumour location. Real answers are organ level, which matches the SEER site groups; individual subsite codes (such as C34.1) are not in this list.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
